source: epics-from-prd.md (repo root) — the actual AAVA-generated epic/feature/story breakdown, reproduced here in full per your instruction. Supersedes the earlier EPIC-1/EPIC-2/EPIC-3 + FEAT-1..13 simulated numbering; all epic/feature IDs below now match epics-from-prd.md exactly (E1/E2/E3, E#.F#).
note: No live Jira in this environment — E1/E2/E3 and E#.F# below are epics-from-prd.md's own IDs, not simulated Jira keys.

epics.name: Automated Regulatory Form Generation and Submission
epics.vision: Enable instant, accurate, and compliant generation and submission of regulatory forms for securities transactions, minimizing manual effort and risk.
goals: Automate SEC Form 4 generation within 5 minutes of transaction execution
Ensure all required form fields are pre-filled and validated
Support legal review and approval prior to submission
Provide audit trail for all form actions
success_metrics: 98% of filings submitted within regulatory deadlines
Zero manual data entry errors per quarter
Average time from transaction to form submission < 30 minutes
100% of forms logged with audit trail
90% adoption rate among eligible executives within 6 months
epics.risks_and_dependencies: Risks include changes to regulatory form templates, integration challenges with EquatePlus APIs, and potential data mapping errors. Dependencies include up-to-date regulatory standards, EquatePlus transaction data, and secure notification infrastructure.

features.name: Automatic SEC Form 4 Generation
features.purpose: Instantly generate pre-filled SEC Form 4 upon transaction execution.
stories: Story 1 — Generate SEC Form 4 after trade
Story 2 — Bulk form generation for multiple trades
Story 3 — Handle incomplete transaction data

features.name: Form Field Validation and Compliance Logic
features.purpose: Ensure all generated forms meet regulatory standards before submission.
stories: Story 1 — Validate form fields before submission
Story 2 — Update validation logic for regulatory changes

features.name: Legal Review and Approval Workflow
features.purpose: Allow legal and compliance users to review, edit, and approve forms before submission.
stories: Story 1 — Edit pre-filled form before submission
Story 2 — Approve form for submission
Story 3 — Audit log edits and approvals

features.name: Audit Logging and Historical Filing Access
features.purpose: Maintain a complete audit trail of all form actions and provide access to historical filings.
stories: Story 1 — View historical filings and statuses
Story 2 — Audit log access for compliance

epics.name: Real-Time Data Streaming, Notifications, and Monitoring
epics.vision: Deliver real-time, secure data streaming and actionable notifications to legal teams and executives, ensuring timely compliance and proactive risk management.
goals: Stream transaction and form data to legal teams in real time
Notify users of form generation, submission, and deadline risks
Provide a dashboard for monitoring filing status and errors
Enable export of filing data for audits
success_metrics: Dashboard reflects filing status changes within 1 minute
All deadline risk alerts sent with >99% reliability
Accessibility compliance verified by WCAG 2.1 AA audit
epics.risks_and_dependencies: Risks include notification delivery failures, dashboard latency, and accessibility gaps. Dependencies include secure messaging infrastructure, dashboard UI, and export services.

features.name: Real-Time Data Streaming to Legal Teams
features.purpose: Deliver transaction and form data to legal and compliance users instantly.
features.mvp_note: Simplified into direct dashboard API polling in the MVP; a dedicated streaming component is the documented target (see hld.md).
stories: Story 1 — Stream form data to legal team
Story 2 — Handle data delivery failure

features.name: Notification System for Filings and Deadlines
features.purpose: Notify executives and legal teams of form generation, submission, and deadline risks.
features.mvp_note: In-app channel only; email/SMS designed but not built.
stories: Story 1 — Notify executive of form generation
Story 2 — Alert on filing deadline risk
Story 3 — Confirm successful submission

features.name: Compliance Dashboard for Monitoring and Alerts
features.purpose: Provide a real-time dashboard for legal and compliance users to monitor filing statuses, deadlines, and errors.
stories: Story 1 — Monitor filing statuses in dashboard
Story 2 — Display error alerts in dashboard

features.name: Export Filing Data for Audits
features.purpose: Allow legal users to export filing data in CSV or PDF format for internal audits.
stories: Story 1 — Export filing data for audit

features.name: Accessibility and High Availability Compliance
features.purpose: Ensure the platform is accessible to all users and meets reliability standards.
features.mvp_note: WCAG-conscious UI patterns applied where free (semantic HTML, keyboard nav, no emoji-as-icon per computershare-design-system.md); full audit and HA/failover infra out of MVP scope.
stories: Story 1 — Use platform with screen reader
Story 2 — System failover during filing window

epics.name: Error Handling, Edge Cases, and Extensibility
epics.vision: Robustly handle errors, edge cases, and support future extensibility for additional regulatory forms and analytics.
goals: Detect and notify on transaction data sync errors
Handle edge cases such as rapid trade succession
Support future regulatory forms beyond SEC Form 4
Enable integration with third-party compliance analytics
success_metrics: 100% of data sync errors detected and notified within 1 minute
No filings omitted in edge case scenarios
Support for at least one additional regulatory form within 12 months
Zero critical errors during bulk trade processing
Extensibility validated by successful integration with analytics tool
epics.risks_and_dependencies: Risks include unhandled edge cases, regulatory changes, and third-party integration failures. Dependencies include EquatePlus APIs, regulatory standards, and analytics tool APIs.

features.name: Transaction Data Sync Error Detection and Notification
features.purpose: Detect failures in transaction data synchronization and notify legal users immediately.
stories: Story 1 — Receive error notification on data sync failure

features.name: Edge Case Handling for Rapid Trade Succession
features.purpose: Ensure all filings are generated and submitted when multiple trades occur in rapid succession.
stories: Story 1 — Handle multiple trades in rapid succession

features.name: Extensibility for Additional Regulatory Forms
features.purpose: Support additional regulatory forms such as SEC Form 5 or Form 144.
features.mvp_note: The form-template-registry abstraction is present in the MVP code (single FORM_4 entry) so the extensibility path is real, even though Form 5/144 templates aren't built.
stories: Story 1 — Add support for new regulatory form

features.name: Integration with Third-Party Compliance Analytics
features.purpose: Enable integration with external analytics tools for advanced compliance reporting.
stories: Story 1 — Provide data to compliance analytics tool
